R9571.summary: Castelcicala to Cavaliere Luigi de' Medici: France wants Cardinal Castiglioni as Pope, the Duc de Laval is blamed, and France and Austria have no accord on the election. Read from its contemporary interlinear decipherment.
R9571.en:
France wishes Cardinal [?Vo...] Castiglione for Pope; but the Duc de Laval is blamed for having made this too visible,
and it is feared that this may harm the said cardinal in his elevation to the Pontifica[te]. There is no agreement
between France [and] Austria for the election of the Pontiff.

R9589.summary: Castelcicala to Cavaliere Luigi de' Medici: the Spanish king's liberty, and the Duc d'Angoulême not expected back for two months. Read from its contemporary interlinear decipherment.
R9589.en:
[?having] the liberty of the King of Spain, and the orders Your Excellency gave me in your despatch in cipher no. 688
of 28 Sept., there can no longer be any question of my passing to the Conference the Note Your Excellency sent me with
the said despatch. I submit them for the Sovereign's information. ⟨I have the honour to be with deep respect, Your
Excellency's ...⟩ The Duke of Angoulême will not be back here for two months.
